These findings suggest that SB-269970 may modulate the activity of these enzymes, which in turn affect the expression or function of TAR DNA-binding protein 43. The integration of these pathways implies that SB-269970 could exert its effects through a complex network of molecular interactions, potentially influencing gene regulation or cellular processes involving TAR DNA-binding protein 43. The evidence supports a mechanism where SB-269970 indirectly affects TAR DNA-binding protein 43 via its targets, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
